'''The Claw''' was a criminal organization based in either [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]] or its neighboring planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It aided the escape of [[Durge/Legends#Legacy|"Project Durge"]] which soon after started collecting bounties with them.
